Branch on descriptor flag bits (a3 & 0xFC0000) != 0 to select the orientation path versus the arithmetic comparison path.
FloatComparisonCheck(this) decides which orientation routine to run on the flag path.
VehicleOrientationFromEulerAngles(a3+8, this+2, a3+4) converts Euler angles to a vehicle orientation when the check passes.
sub_4B32A0(a3+8, this+2, a3+4) performs the alternative orientation/state update when the check fails.
ArithmeticComparison_3a90(this+2, a3) stores comparison data on the non-orientation path.
